experiments.notes: v6 adds native /antiafk on|off|toggle|status commands sharing the exact same g_antiAfkEnabled state as the SUMMON GUI toggle. Four no-argument WoW Lua C functions are registered through exact-build FrameScript_RegisterFunction 0x00704120 after world readiness; the slash dispatcher is reinstalled every 30s so /reload can self-heal. Slash feedback is deferred to the next UI timer tick to avoid nested FrameScript execution. Also fixes v5 ordering so Anti-AFK remains active when AutoSummon itself is disabled. Anti-AFK remains per-process/background-safe, random 120-360s, and due jumps defer during cast/channel.
